actions.newValue: Zinnie Harris's updated version of John Webster's Jacobean tragedy is set in a contemporary world not far from Naples. The Duchess, a formidable woman, finds herself at the mercy of her brothers' greed and vice in a harrowing story of power, control and violence.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: In this London Palladium Christmas pantomime, Robin and Marian have left the castle and are caring for the forgotten children of Nottingham in Sherwood Forest, where the children are cold and hungry. When Prince John and the Lords and Ladies of London travel north to visit the castle, Robin sees his chance and plans a festive heist against the new Sheriff.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Shakespeare's late play follows the exiled magician of a remote island, who uses a conjured storm and the spirit Ariel to bring old enemies ashore and settle scores. Jamie Lloyd directs the production at Theatre Royal Drury Lane.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: A wordless, hour-long piece of sound theatre follows two animals on a summer's day in adjacent English fields: a cow, who gives birth to a calf, and a roe deer. Four performers and Foley artists create the animals' world live with everyday objects, inviting the audience to listen from the animals' point of view.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Miriam is a mother living in the aftermath of the disappearance of her teenage son, Oscar. Nick Payne's play jumps through time to show her refusal to give up hope after unimaginable loss, with black comedy running through its portrait of grief.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Shakespeare's tragedy moves to the modern age, where the Moorish military commander Othello is riding high on his war victories and his passionate marriage to Desdemona. His supposed friend Iago manipulates him into believing she has been unfaithful, sending Othello down a devastating path of jealousy and destruction.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Ani has turned to hardcore porn over the years, and her boyfriend Liam feels increasingly shut out of her erotic imagination. Sophia Chetin-Leuner's play weaves her story together with Milton's Eve, linking sexual desire, grief for her mother and the pull of male coercion.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: On a bright day in June 2016, Alfie and Julie, a couple in their late fifties, wait at their Harringay home for the arrival of their daughter Annabelle. Alfie is dying of cancer, and in this real-time two-hander the couple talk with frank intimacy as they prepare for a final parting. It is the last play in David Eldridge's trilogy about love, after Beginning and Middle.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Simon Stephens's adaptation of Chekhov's Uncle Vanya strips the play down to a single performer, who plays every role. Andrew Scott moves between the unhappy title character, his aged mother, a crusading doctor, a glamorous siren and a plain, lovelorn niece, keeping the comedy and the tragedy of the story in balance.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Brian Foster's monologue tells the life of Myra McLaughlin, who grows up in an unstable household but with a roof over her head. Over the course of her story she falls victim to the alcohol dependence her father called the Beast, and ends up begging on the streets of Dublin.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: A lavish Mongolian theatrical spectacle staged at the London Coliseum, centred on Archug Khan, a fictional hero. The production was mounted to raise Mongolia's profile internationally.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Faye cannot sleep after a sexual assault, and asks her older brother Naoise to help with a plan she calls exposure therapy: re-enacting the attack to overcome its hold on her. Naoise, who is himself accused of assault after kissing a woman at work, has to decide what he will do in this 70-minute psychological thriller.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Arthur Miller's drama is set among the Italian-American families of Brooklyn's waterfront, where a longshoreman's protective devotion to his niece curdles into obsession after two of his wife's relatives arrive illegally from Italy. This production, which came to the Theatre Royal Haymarket after a sell-out season in Bath, plays the tragedy through to its fatal conclusion.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: A quiescent English couple, Peter and Debbie, meet the blowsy American Elsa on a cruise, and she promptly muscles her way into their lives. When she announces on Facebook that she and her luggage are waiting at their front door, a quick Google search reveals her murderous past, and the couple start to fear they could be next in Steven Moffat's comic thriller.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Gary Owen's Welsh comedy-drama updates Shakespeare's lovers to modern-day Splott. Romey is an unemployed single dad with a raging alcoholic mother, and Julie is a clever teenager heading to Cambridge to read physics. Their families are not feuding, but their different upbringings make the future of their romance uncertain.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Based on the television series, this original musical compresses an entire Bake Off series and eight amateur bakers into two acts. The bakers compete to be crowned star baker while two judges preside over the tent.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Frank Wildhorn, Don Black and Ivan Menchell's musical tells the story of the young criminal couple Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow, who spent the early 1930s robbing banks and speeding across America with the law in pursuit. It begins at the end, with the pair in a shot-out car, then traces their love, family loyalty and frustrated aspirations during the Great Depression.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Six Black British men, named after aspects of blackness such as Jet, Onyx, Obsidian and Sable, meet in what appears to be a therapy session, seated on a line of plastic chairs. Ryan Calais Cameron's choreopoem mixes monologue, movement and music as they open up about racism, police stop-and-search, school, history and what it feels like to be British and Black.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Tatenda Shamiso's one-man show is built around a largely one-sided call to the No I.D. Hotline, a trial run for the real call he will have to make to the tax authorities. He tells the story of discovering at 19 that he was not a girl, transitioning from Thandiwe to Tatenda, and trying to get his gender and name changed on his documents as a Black immigrant trans man.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Based on the satirical puppet television show, this musical follows a gang of celebrities led by Tom Cruise who must save Britain, with a puppet Ian McKellen as master of ceremonies. Along the way it lampoons politicians and public figures.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Andrew Lloyd Webber's sung-through musical, adapted from David Garnett's 1955 novel, tracks a tangle of love affairs across generations. George, his partner Rose and his young nephew Alex are caught up in desire and jealousy that turns violent when Alex shoots Rose.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: In the dystopian People's Republic of Koka Kola, once the UK and now ruled by the most powerful brands, fortysomething Hope returns home after 24 years abroad. She left her newborn son to be raised by her sister Lor, whose commune has since failed and who is struggling with alcohol addiction, and Hope sets out across the brand-owned landscape to find them.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Rabiah Hussain's play has no conventional narrative, instead presenting a series of sketches about how language is misused, policed, cherished or supplanted in today's London. A five-strong cast shows how a first language can colonise and even destroy mother tongues, and marginalise those who do not fit the monolingual norm.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: This musical traces Bob Marley's life from a childhood in which he was abandoned by his father, through the trio he formed with Peter Tosh and Bunny Wailer in the hope of escaping the ghetto. It follows his marriage to Rita Anderson and his affairs, and the civil war, political unrest and assassination attempt that surrounded him as he became a reggae star.
actions.description: BRO-6075: backfill empty West End historical synopsis, written from the show's collected review texts

actions.newValue: Set on the boat during the troubled shoot of Jaws, the play finds Robert Shaw, Richard Dreyfuss and Roy Scheider stuck at sea while the mechanical sharks keep failing. Shaw drinks heavily, Dreyfuss is difficult and Scheider tries to keep the peace. Co-written by Shaw's son Ian, who plays his own father.
